title: Input-prefix shift invariance
statement: Let $R$ be a number of registers, let $\Lambda$ be a set of labels, and let $P$ be a counter program over them. For any bit strings $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{suffix}$, any abstract state $s$, and any $t\in\mathbb{N}$, running for $t$ steps on the concatenated input $\mathrm{pre}\,\mathrm{suffix}$ from the state whose read position is shifted forward by $|\mathrm{pre}|$ gives the state obtained by shifting the read position of the $t$-step run on $\mathrm{suffix}$ from $s$ forward by $|\mathrm{pre}|$.
hypotheses_covered: A counter program $P$ over these registers and labels
